messages:
axel: Heads-up — thinking about a small UX add for the Permissions page: an "effective permissions preview" toggle that shows what a user/team can actually do after all role+scope rules resolve. Could help troubleshooting tenant confusion.
priya: Nice. Is this different from the current 'simulate role' modal?
axel: Yes — simulate role is manual. Preview would be computed for the selected principal in the context of the current route/policy + any tenant overrides. Show computed allow/deny per-action.
maya: Love the idea. We get support requests where customers say "I added role X but they still can't call route Y" — this would make root cause visible.
jonah: Implementation question: do we compute this on-the-fly in the console (API call) or precompute in telemetry/engine? On-the-fly could be expensive for big orgs.
axel: Proposal: an API endpoint that evaluates policies with options for cached vs live. Default to cached for list view, live for one-off debug. Cache keyed by (principal, route-version, policy-hash).
olivia: UX note — show the delta from role baseline. e.g., "Role devs: can generate embeddings, but blocked on 'model:invoke' because org override denies". Color-code allow/deny and a small explainer line.
priya: Also show which policy clause caused the deny (entitlement, tenant override, time-based rule). That will reduce back-and-forth with support.
jonah: API shape suggestion (simple):
```
POST /api/v1/policies/evaluate
{
  "principal": "team:billing",
  "resource": "route:generate_embedding",
  "context": { "tenant": "acme", "route_version": "v2" },
  "live": true
}
```
axel: Exactly. Response would be list of evaluated actions with source pointers to policy ids and a small human message.
infra-bot: audit-log: permission-check evaluevent id=ae3f2 user=axel target=policies/evaluate status=queued (for visibility)
maya: One more product ask: add a tiny "reproduce" button that opens a prefilled support ticket template (or copies evaluation JSON) — speeds [support <> customer] debugging.
priya: Concerning RBAC schema: we should limit preview to structured actions (not free-text). Otherwise we end up with strongly coupled UI-to-policy parsing logic.
jonah: Agree. We'll map console actions to canonical action ids used by runtime. If a new action appears, fallback to "unknown action — contact infra".
olivia: Rollout plan: feature flag for accounts, expose to org-admins only at first. Provide telemetry for how often preview used, and whether it led to policy changes.
axel: Good. Also surface an audit-toolbar in the permissions view: last 5 evals for that principal, quick diff between two evals.
priya: We should be careful about exposing sensitive principals in shared dashboards. Only org-admins and support with proper audit permissions see full details. 
maya: Also include an opt-out for customers who don't want policy caching for privacy reasons.
jonah: Dev task list:
- API endpoint + evaluator hook (live/cache)
- Console component + delta renderer
- Backend cache key + invalidation on policy change
- Event to telemetry + support ticket template
(axel) I'll write a short RFC and add rough wireframes.
olivia: If you want UI help, I can pair on the delta renderer — will mock up compact rows with action, result, policy-id, and reason. :+1:
priya: sounds like a plan. tagging @olivia when RFC is up.
axel: Thanks all — feel free to drop quick replies. We'll keep this behind a feature-flag and run a canary on a few internal orgs first. :eyes:
